design.host_role: Dawn of Defiance is the playable world and action layer.
design.companion_role: Ancestors supplies real evolution/survival progression data from the player's installed copy.
first_minute: Complete one hunt or combat encounter.
Award the first evolution-linked upgrade based on Ancestors data.
design.cross_game_mechanic: Evolution-linked progression gates a small set of Dawn of Defiance survival/combat upgrades.
design.scope: One compact progression loop; no copied game assets.
